text:
And it was then

that with the dead cold tongue in his mouth

he sang the song they let him sing

in this world of obscene gardens and shadows

that came at the wrong hour to remind him

of songs from his boyhood

when he could not sing the song he wanted to sing

the song they let him sing

except through his absent blue eyes

through his absent mouth

through his absent voice.

Then, from the highest tower of absence

his song resounded in the opacity of what was hidden

in the silent expanse

full of shifting hollows like the words I write.

translation.title: Poem for the Father
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the repeated allowed song and the final movement into hidden absence.
